propositions: checkout-index subprocess call in _apply_delta has no timeout parameter while its sibling read-tree call is bounded by _GIT_TIMEOUT (300s)
checkout-index is the expensive filesystem-heavy operation in _apply_delta and most likely to stall on slow or wedged volumes, yet has no upper bound or diagnostic on hang
the call bypasses git_run wrapper (which enforces timeout) and uses run_git directly with no timeout argument, creating asymmetric failure handling within a single function
timeout exception from unbounded checkout-index can escape _apply_delta instead of being caught and returned as False to trigger caller fallback to full materialization
the git_run wrapper cannot accept stdin (no input_data parameter) which forces the site to bypass it and use run_git directly, creating the timeout gap
